label: 802.3af to 12V DC gigabit PoE splitter
description: Inline splitter that accepts 802.3af PoE on one RJ45 and hands out clean 12 VDC at 1 A (12 W) on a 2.1x5.5 mm barrel while passing gigabit data through to the device. It lets a 12V-only camera or media player run from a PoE switch; it draws standard af power, so it works on any compliant PSE but not on a passive injector.
